card.name: Body-related text, scattered positions
card.fires_on: Scattered words and punctuation in passages about the human body, such as lean body weight formulas, sunscreen on skin, and patient positioning. No single word type stands out.

modes.label: Body-weight formula
modes.description: Numbers, spaces or equals signs inside a lean body weight calculation.
modes.example: For males: LBW = 50 kg + 2<<.>>3 kg for each inch of patient’s

modes.label: Sunscreen reapplication
modes.description: Commas and the word every in advice on reapplying sunscreen to skin.
modes.example: That much sunscreen should be reapplied every two hours, and even more frequently,<< every>> 60 to 90 minutes

modes.label: Patient positioning
modes.description: The word the before body parts in positioning or procedure instructions.
modes.example: severe swelling in<< the>> legs Before the Procedure

card.writes: It lowers the chance of body or skin words, mostly Chinese ones, coming next.
card.plain: It fires on filler words and punctuation in text about the body, and it holds back body and skin words.
